description: This test confirms that users can access the Privacy Policy page from the footer link.
steps: Scroll down to the footer section of the page.
Locate the Privacy Policy link in the footer.
Click on the Privacy Policy link.
Assert that the Privacy Policy page loads successfully.
expected_results: The Privacy Policy page is loaded successfully.
edge_cases: Page load fails due to server downtime.
The Privacy Policy link is not visible.
data_requirements: Functional Privacy Policy link in the footer.
dependencies: Footer section is correctly rendered on the login page.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the Privacy Policy page.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the Privacy Policy link is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Provide descriptive text for the Privacy Policy link.
Verify that the Privacy Policy page meets accessibility standards.
